description: Machine-readable scientific disposition of every distinct candidate, source partition, controlled-access lead, quarantine and explicit exclusion recorded by the 2026-08-20 TRACE Explorer dataset sweep. Registry presence does not imply that a dataset is downloadable, promoted or analysis-ready.

semantics.available: For analysis capabilities, true means promoted and usable now. Every backlog candidate is false until an immutable release passes audit.

tier.S1: Public expression and linkable endpoint; immediate survival audit priority.
tier.S2: Survival plausible but at least one endpoint, join, baseline or denominator decision remains open.
tier.E1: Priority expression/GSEA candidate; survival is not enabled.
tier.E2: Expression candidate requiring filtering, deduplication, reprocessing or design-specific handling.
tier.C: Controlled or request-only data; no public release is authorized.
tier.Q: Quarantined because independence, selection, mixing or interpretation is unresolved.
tier.X: Excluded from the current analytical contract or retained only as an alternate distribution.

inventory_coverage.rule: Every distinct candidate or source partition in the sweep tables has exactly one stable id, tier, status, access class, capability decision and blocker. Cross-references to cohorts already integrated are represented only when the sweep assigns them an explicit duplicate or alternate-distribution decision.
